name: optimize-shiny-performance
description: Profile and optimize Shiny application performance using profvis, bindCache, memoise, async/promises, debounce/throttle, and ExtendedTask for long-running computations. Use when the app feels slow or unresponsive during user interaction, when server resources are exhausted under concurrent load, when specific operations create bottlenecks, or when preparing an app for production deployment with many concurrent users.
